title: Sheet 10 · Parts list
summary: SHEET 10/14 documents the handover like an engineering document: a true 30° axonometric of the Kelwin mark, cut at its joins into five parts and exploded forward along its extrusion axis off its dashed datum, keyed by part tags to a stacked-tab parts list where every Owner reads CLIENT, with one red plane marking the part under review.

reference.borrowed: Joby's technical summary sheet: one top hairline, a vertical stack of tab headings with the active one in ink and the others muted at the same size, a narrow hairline-ruled key/value spec table, and one large 1px isometric line drawing with a small 'Fig. 6.1' caption pinned to the field. No fills, photos or cards; it reads as a page from an engineering document.
reference.kelwin: Joby's composition is mirrored into C's sheet anatomy inside the continuous frame. The title cell carries the red-square sheet label, 'WHEN WE LEAVE, / THE SYSTEM / STAYS.' at 88px wide caps with its turn dropped to the light voice in --fg-3, and the 48×2 red rule. The note cell pairs the mono coda with the 24px light lede. The aircraft becomes FIG. 10.1: the corrected three-piece mark in exact 30° axonometric (14U plates, 1.8 px per unit), cut at its own joins into five parts and exploded straight toward the viewer in 44U steps (K1's limbs, then K2's, then the core). Every part keeps its place in the mark, so the logo still reads as layers coming forward. Dotted guides trace each part back to its seat on the dashed datum, the assembled mark (P-06 Rebuild Sequence). The one red plane is the K3 core's front face (P-05 Signal Dashboard). Six orthogonal leaders end in boxed part tags over a dashed construction grid. Joby's stacked headings become C's inverted tabs [01] Parts list / [02] Transfer terms. Its key/value table becomes the parts list (Part · Item · Format · Owner = CLIENT). The quiet door is a bordered cell, so the plane stays the sheet's only red besides the head's label square and rule. The bottom band holds a legend and the title block, and a vertical UTC readout sits on the frame edge.

motion: entrance (drafting order): the frame verticals and crosshairs fade in (300ms) and the cell borders draw in raster order (500ms, 40ms stagger). The title lines wipe in left to right, the red rule draws, and the tabs and parts-list rows fade in as empty cells. The drawing then plots: the dashed construction grid, then the datum (the assembled mark's outline), then the explosion guides, then each part's three faces drawn by stroke-dashoffset (900ms, 120ms stagger, about 0.8–2.3s).

the one orchestrated moment (keyed annotation): from 2.0s the parts list is entered row by row, 180ms apart. Each row's Item, Format and Owner type on at 24ms per character as its leader plots onto the drawing (400ms) and its part tag fades in. When the P-05 row is entered (about 2.9s), the red plane drops onto the K3 core's front face (opacity plus an 8px settle, 400ms). P-06's leader to the datum closes the sequence at about 3.4s.
ambient: the vertical UTC readout on the frame edge updates every 6s with a 200ms dip. Nothing else loops.

interaction: hovering a parts-list row moves the red plane to that part (600ms cross-fade, part outline to --fg) and turns its tag box and leader --accent; hovering P-06 turns the datum outline red instead. Tabs [01]/[02] swap the parts list for the transfer terms (Ownership · Format · Handover · Deprecation risk 0 [%]). The bordered cell inverts on hover.
on the live site: the sheet plots once when it is 50% visible, and the keyed annotation follows. prefers-reduced-motion shows the fully plotted sheet with P-05 selected.
notes: Critique pass: the first explosion pushed the parts outward in-plane as well as forward, so the mark no longer read. The drawing is regenerated from the 152-unit master, exploding along the extrusion axis only, with explosion guides added and the tags re-routed (four left, two right; P-04 runs under the assembly). The head now follows the founder spec (red-square label, 88px, --display-tracking, light turn, red rule), so the title row grows to four 96px modules and the sheet to 1104px. Numbered SHEET 10/14 and FIG. 10.1 to match the C set's page-order numbering. Copy is verbatim from AssetInventory.tsx, with formats in caps. The tab [02] values follow the source TERMS, with 'Zero' set as a 0 [%] cell numeral.
